history.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a brand NEW unlabeled PNG background for a Chinese machine learning textbook; all supplied images are EXTERNAL scientific mechanism references only, not edit targets or layout templates. Invent a fresh clear composition appropriate to the following objects and relations. Flat 2D technical illustration, pure #FFFFFF background and perfectly uniform solid opaque fills. Lancet muted Blue #7B95C6, Green #67A583, Peach #FFC1A6 and Rose #C85E62 with very pale fixed white mixes. Neutral thin wires #4C4D4F. Many modules can remain white with colored outlines; restrained pale grouping only where it explains a relation. Crisp planar mechanism glyphs and accurate connections, readable blank areas. No 3D, perspective, side faces, extrusions, shadows, gloss, gradients, paper/canvas texture, noise, grain, waves, stripes, cloudy color variation or decorative card grids. At most one decorative icon per frame; equivalent frames consistently use the same or no icon. Mechanism nodes, vectors, documents and samples are allowed. NO text, letters, digits, formulas, plus/minus signs, pseudowriting, watermark or legends anywhere. Reserve adjacent or internal blank title/variable spaces; all lettering added later from actual fonts. Never put a decorative icon where a title must sit. Generous outer white margins. Landscape composition.
Scientific mechanism: Contrast two preference-based policy update mechanisms. Shared preference-pair dataset: prompt glyph and two response documents with one green and one rose border, indicates preferred versus rejected, no marks/text inside. Branch A RLHF: preference dataset→reward-model fitting→one fixed reward scorer. A distinct current policy produces sampled response→fixed reward scorer→one score signal→policy update module; policy update returns only to current policy. Distinct reference policy supplies KL constraint into policy update, NOT a reward training target. Reward model not updated by policy loop. Branch B DPO: same preference dataset together with current policy and fixed reference policy supply preference log-ratio comparison/objective→policy update returning ONLY to DPO current policy. DPO no independent reward-model or live generation loop. Prefer clear two mechanism regions with sufficient spaces below modules for labels; no decorative trophies or double-network clusters. Models may be one planar small network each. All directional arrows unambiguous.

science_brief.title: RLHF与DPO的反馈连接方式
science_brief.understanding_gap: 比较反馈、奖励模型和策略更新的职责在数十行文字中展开，目前只有目标偏离和执行授权图，缺少两条训练路径的对照。
proposed_mechanism: 共同输入是提示及成对偏好，RLHF路线训练奖励模型，再固定评价器对当前策略采样评分并更新策略；参考策略提供KL约束。
DPO路线直接用偏好对、当前策略与参考策略构成目标并更新策略，不增加独立奖励模型或在线奖励调用。
明确标签误差与覆盖限制仍共享，不画成安全认证。
science_brief.evidence:
384: 
385: 获得评价之后，还需要让生成策略改变选择。显式训练奖励模型并用它优化策略，与直接从成对偏好调整策略，是连接相对评价和行为概率的两条路线。两者共享前面的评价误差与覆盖限制；是否单独保留奖励模型，不会改变反馈本身的真伪。
386: 
387: \term{人类反馈强化学习}（reinforcement learning from human feedback, RLHF）的一条常见路线，是把“人能比较少量行为”转化为“奖励模型能给大量新行为评分”，再用该奖励优化策略。Christiano等的工作比较行为片段，以学习到的偏好预测作为强化学习奖励，连接了人的判断与策略优化。比较反馈可以比直接示范更容易获得，但标签分歧、遗漏因素和奖励模型外推都会进入最终行为，偏好拟合不等于完整的使用安全保证\scite{christiano2017}。
388: 
389: 实际学习形成循环：当前策略产生候选行为，人比较其中一部分，奖励模型更新后再指导策略。继续收集新策略产生的数据，可以减少只依赖初始行为样本的局限，但也增加反馈成本。
390: 
391: 在一次策略更新中，先固定奖励模型，从当前策略采样完整回答或行动轨迹，并计算每个样本的奖励。更新再利用“该样本的得分比当前通常水平高多少”来调整它的生成概率：高于基准的样本获得增加概率的信号，低于基准的样本获得相反信号。奖励模型提供训练信号，策略参数承担行为改变；若更新的是奖励模型而策略不动，生成行为不会因此自动改善。后续重新采样可以看到这种概率变化实际带来了哪些新候选。

caption: 两条路线共享提示及成对偏好。RLHF先拟合奖励模型，在一次策略更新内固定评价器，对当前策略采样回答评分，再以参考策略的KL约束更新当前策略。DPO直接用偏好、当前策略与固定参考策略构成目标并更新当前策略，不另训练奖励模型。偏好覆盖不足与标签噪声仍影响两条路线。
